The buyer is likely to prevail, so the answer is C. The shutters were custom-made and screwed and bracketed into the window frames, so they were attached to the realty. Under the fixture test (annexation, adaptation and intent), they became fixtures and passed with the home even though the sales agreement didn't mention them. The warranty deed covenants (title and encumbrances) don't cover the removal of fixtures, so D is wrong. Repairing the frames doesn't change what was conveyed, so B is wrong.

CONFIDENCE: 88
